name: 👩‍💻 Maria Meier Endler
headline: Head of Agentic Systems and Engineering | LLMs and Reinforcement Learning | CDTM | Founder and previously CTO of Phantasma Labs
summary:
Maria Meier is a deep tech AI leader and sought-after speaker on topics at the intersection of Reinforcement Learning, Large Language Models, and responsible AI. Currently, she leads fine-tuning and evaluation efforts for frontier LLMs at Aleph Alpha.

As the Co-Founder and former CTO of Phantasma Labs, Maria built a diverse, world-class AI team and delivered simulation-driven products that are redefining mobility and industrial planning. She has shipped multiple products from scratch, each built on novel technology stacks and shaped by close client collaboration.

Maria has shared her insights on platforms like the Alphalist CTO podcast (2022), where she spoke about responsible AI and the future of mobility. She is also the winner of the She Loves Tech Award (2019) for deep-tech female founders.

She brings not just technical depth—across RL, MLOps, LLMs, and cloud—but also a passion for communicating AI’s challenges and potential to diverse audiences, from engineers to executives. Whether on stage or in the lab, Maria is focused on shaping a future where AI is not only powerful, but transparent, fair, and human-aligned.

Co-Founder and CTO of Phantasma, a deep-tech AI startup to solve mobility and industrial planning solutions. In those 5 years I have:

- Shipped 3 products on completely different tech stacks from scratch. Managed discovery, client interviews, planning, delivery and support for all of them

- Created and managed a world-class AI team in Reinforcement Learning, with data science researchers (3 w/PhDs),  data engineers and ML-Ops. We build our own training environments and feedback & evaluation mechanisms 

- Hired 20+ employees, trained 2 people managers. Created hiring pipelines, did screening interviews and technical challenges for game engineers, front-end engineers, backend engineers, game design artists, data science engineers, QA engineers, ML Ops and DevOps engineers

- Built and maintained cloud infrastructure on AWS, CI/CD pipelines thought GitHub, monitoring costs and availability for cost-intensive AI training models
